retrievalProfile.description: A soft-focus portrait integrated with a landscape via double exposure, featuring high-contrast serif typography across the top.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, soft-focus portrait of a woman with voluminous hair, illuminated by a strong golden backlight. The subject's clothing features a double-exposure effect showing a forest landscape with deer. The top of the frame is occupied by large, elegant serif typography in contrasting colors.
coreVisualRelationships: Backlight glow creates a halo effect around the subject's hair
Double exposure blends the subject's torso with a pastoral forest scene
Large-scale title text sits flush with the top edge, framing the head
Secondary metadata is organized in symmetrical columns flanking the face
coreInvariants: Double exposure texture in the lower third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-close-up portrait, filling approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright glow of the hair on the right side.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large title text, moves down to the eyes, then follows the double-exposure texture into the landscape details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Darker forest background on the left provides contrast for the white text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted greens and browns in the background and double exposure.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for primary display text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft pastel pink for secondary title emphasis.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value highlights from the backlighting.

letterConstructionRules: Significant stroke contrast between thicks and thins
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for titles paired with a functional, small-scale sans-serif for lists.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, tight-kerning serif look of the 60s.
Provides the necessary weight and vintage feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus 1960s style portrait of a woman with voluminous hair. Use a double exposure effect on her floral-patterned blouse to reveal a misty forest with deer. Apply a strong golden backlight from the right side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large serif title across the top edge. Use white for the first half and dusty pink for the second. Add two columns of small, all-caps sans-serif text on either side of the subject's head.

verificationChecks: Is the backlight creating a visible glow on the hair?
Is the double exposure confined primarily to the clothing?
Is the title text high-contrast and tightly spaced?
Does the image have a grainy, film-like texture?

postGenerationChecks: Check for 1960s film aesthetic (grain and bloom)
Verify the serif font has sharp, elegant terminals
Ensure the double exposure doesn't obscure the facial features
Confirm the two-tone color split in the main title
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus portrait + Backlit halo + Double exposure landscape + Tight serif display type = 1960s Nostalgic Cover Art
